# A refilled with 500.00 USD from C, as in
# usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_refilled.txt, but written wholly in
# US dollars.
#
# It repays what A owes, which cost 1.35, with dollars C held at 1.30, so it
# realizes 25.00 CAD, and a transaction with no split in Canadian dollars has
# nowhere to state it. It is refused, as a US dollar loan repaid out of US
# dollars held at another cost is.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.

	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:USD C -500.00 USD
		cost_basis_split_guid: "0a0a0000000000000000000000000003"
	Assets:USD A 500.00 USD
